title: Issue or not
body:
I resently had a bad libre sensor wich gave me constantly the very high value of 481.xxx mgdl hours after seting wich i didn't realised in the first. But i was very confused, that after the initial calibration (was at 130mgdl) all previous values were gone in the timeline. But that i saw that they were actually pushed below the zero line due to the big calibration delta.

Should'nt it be so that if you stop the old sensor and start a new one the old value should stay

comments.body:
(Sorry:-D)
...where they are? In my case the old data from the old sensor were also recalibrated with the calibration of the new sensor. 
Plugin was dactricsae.

I also have an issue with this plugin or xdrip+ itself, that i get sometimes different readings on the phone and on the watch. Phone seems to show the plugin value and the watch seems to show the xdrip calibrated value..
481.xxx means it was always the same raw value for 2 hours after setting. But i dont remember the xxx.
Do you know which version you are running where you got this effect?

Ok, lets concentrate on the issue not having the same value on phone and watch.
When i look on my timeline i have 2 curves. One is blue - must be the Plugin curve - and one is faded, wich should be the original or raw curve.
I would guess, that the raw curve has the values wich come to the watch.
If i tap " send data to watch" the values get mostly equal. Sometimes the value is equal then but not the direction.
